## About
Green Oval Motors is a Land Rover shop at 121 NE Weidler St in Portland. Our ASE Certified Technicians work on Land Rovers and Range Rovers with dealer level diagnostic tools.
We'd rather tell you what your vehicle actually needs than sell you work it doesn't. One longtime customer put it simply: no need to drive to the slurbs to be overcharged by the dealer.
Doug, Shawn and the crew take the time to explain what we find and help you plan for future maintenance. Stop by or give us a call during the week.

## Services
- Land Rover Service: Maintenance and service for Land Rovers and Range Rovers, with a plan for what's coming next.
- Repair: Repairs on Land Rover and Range Rover models, with updates along the way.
- Dealer level diagnostics: We use dealer level diagnostic tools to find out what's going on before any work starts.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on Range Rovers too?
A: Yes. We look after Range Rovers as well as other Land Rover models.

Q: Will you push work I don't need?
A: No. We'll tell you honestly what your vehicle needs and leave the choice with you.
